archSubtitle: Each stage is executed by a separately accountable institution, with physical isolation between fiat and crypto flows — the core design principle of compliance.

archSteps.label: Business Verification
archSteps.title: KYC / KYB & Trade Background
archSteps.desc: Onboarding with scenario-based eligibility assessment, order matching and reconciliation. Genuine trade documentation verified at entry point to establish lawful transaction basis.

archSteps.label: Fiat Acquiring
archSteps.title: Card & Alternative Payments

archSteps.label: Compliant Routing

archSteps.desc: The MSO handles fiat settlement only. Licensed OTC institutions independently execute stablecoin conversion under their own compliance obligations — no commingling.

archSteps.label: Partner Execution
archSteps.title: Settlement & Wallet Ecosystem
archSteps.desc: Stablecoins delivered directly to client self-custody wallets. The platform never takes possession — settlement is cryptographically verifiable on-chain.

isolationLabel: Physical separation — no commingling of flows or institutions

compTitle: Compliance Built Into the Product Design
compTitleAccent: Not Bolted On After the Fact
compSubtitle: Compliance is not an add-on — it shapes every decision from licensing scope to architecture to how client assets are handled.
compStatement: MSB registration is an AML compliance prerequisite — not a comprehensive financial licence, not an official endorsement, and not an authorisation to engage in deposit-taking, banking or securities business.

compCards.title: Canada MSB Registration
compCards.desc: Registered with FINTRAC under the Proceeds of Crime (Money Laundering) and Terrorist Financing Act. This registration serves as the AML prerequisite for our fiat payment routing services and does not constitute government endorsement.

compCards.title: Retail Payment Services
compCards.desc: Acknowledging the PSP registration requirements under the Retail Payment Activities Act administered by the Bank of Canada, with ongoing monitoring of regulatory developments.

compCards.title: Risk-Based Control Framework
compCards.desc: Full-scope obligations including KYC, KYB, sanctions screening, FATF Travel Rule compliance, transaction monitoring and applicable 24-hour suspicious transaction reporting.

compCards.title: Clear Boundary Statement
compCards.desc: We do not provide investment advice, promise yield, hold client assets on balance sheet, accept deposits, issue security tokens, or engage in trade matching. Every boundary is stated, auditable and enforced.

compDisclaimer: This platform provides payment routing and software technology services only. It does not provide investment advice or guarantee asset performance. All virtual asset exchange and related financial services are independently provided by appropriately licensed institutions and remain subject to formal agreements and permitted scope. Services and availability vary by jurisdiction, client eligibility and partner coverage.
mpcTitle: Non-Custodial by Architecture, Not by Promise
mpcText: The 2-of-3 threshold signature model ensures that no single party — neither the platform nor any external actor — can unilaterally move client assets. This is a structural guarantee, not a policy statement.

mpcShards.label: Shard 1
mpcShards.title: User Device
mpcShards.desc: One key shard resides on the end user's device. The platform has zero visibility into this shard — it is generated and stored entirely under user control.

mpcShards.label: Shard 2
mpcShards.title: Policy Service
mpcShards.desc: A second shard is held by a co-signing policy engine that enforces transaction rules — velocity limits, whitelist checks, time windows — before any signature can proceed.

mpcShards.label: Shard 3
mpcShards.title: Independent Recovery
mpcShards.desc: A third shard is held by an independent recovery provider. It is never active in normal operations and only used under a predefined disaster recovery protocol.

mpcCommitment: The threshold is 2-of-3. The platform holds at most one shard at any time. Assets can never be moved without explicit user consent.
riskTitle: Key Operational Risks — And How We Address Them
riskSubtitle: Each risk is identified, assessed and mitigated through concrete architectural, legal and operational measures — not hand-waving.

risks.title: Trade Background Authenticity
risks.desc: Fictitious or inflated trade documentation weaken the lawful basis for cross-border payments.
risks.strategyText: Mandatory submission and verification of genuine trade documents at onboarding. Transaction-level reconciliation with order and logistics data. Continuous post-transaction sampling and audit.

risks.title: OTC Third-Party Deposit Restrictions
risks.desc: OTC desks may restrict or reject deposits from third-party sources, creating settlement friction for VA-funded conversions.
risks.strategyText: Pre-vetted OTC partners with explicit third-party deposit policies. Dedicated virtual account architecture ensures clean fund provenance before conversion routing.

risks.title: Repeated KYC Friction
risks.desc: Merchants face redundant KYC/KYB processes across multiple service layers, increasing drop-off and operational cost.
risks.strategyText: Once-verified, multi-use identity architecture. Compliance data is structured for reusability across partner institutions with consent, reducing duplication while maintaining audit integrity.

risks.title: SFC Regulatory Boundaries
risks.desc: Hong Kong SFC licensing requirements impose clear red lines around virtual asset activities that must not be crossed.
risks.strategyText: Strict functional separation: the MSO handles fiat only. Virtual asset exchange is exclusively executed by SFC-licensed (or equivalent) partners under their own regulatory perimeter.

aboutDesc: UnityPay is a global payment settlement technology and software service platform for businesses going overseas, providing product interface, process orchestration, routing instructions, status display and reconciliation support. We connect acquiring, compliance screening and licensed institution execution through a decoupled architecture, ensuring every fund flow has a traceable path. Regulated services related to payments, remittances, exchange and virtual assets are independently provided by qualified partners. Our team has deep expertise in cross-border payments, trade compliance and fintech, committed to connecting merchants, acquiring networks and licensed financial institutions in a transparent and verifiable manner.
